title: Anticancer Analysis of CD44 Targeted Cyclosporine Loaded Thiolated Chitosan Nanoformulations for Sustained Release in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered source-supported MTT and trypan-blue anticancer/cytotoxicity rows; worker-4 preserved the DBAASP sequence/identity limitation as source_conflict while matching the pure-CsA IC50 assay values; worker-6 closed the prior ticket with cautions and no open blocking rework.

paper_xml.coverage: MTT IC50/cell-viability text, Table 7 trypan-blue cytotoxicity rows, CD44/HA targeting context, article metadata.

oa_package.coverage: NXML and Figure 9/10 image assets checked; no extra exact unlabeled chart values promoted.

supplementary_assets.coverage: Supplementary local files are HTML-like/indexed-only assets with no structured activity table; absence is nonblocking because source XML provides activity rows.

supplementary_assets.note: Local supplementary files did not add structured activity/toxicity rows; XML/PDF/OA sources supplied recoverable gate-changing evidence.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked DBAASP IC50 rows are matched to primary-source pure-CsA IC50 values, while sequence/identity verification remains a preserved source_conflict because the local packet has no sequence row and the paper lacks a DBAASP-verifiable sequence table.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: MTT IC50/cell-viability values and Table 7 trypan-blue cytotoxicity values are extracted with raw values, units, targets, conditions, and locators. Figure-only unlabeled bars were not digitized.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to CD44-targeted delivery, computational context, phenotypic cytotoxicity, and qualitative morphology; no direct mechanism is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: The prior blocking ticket is closed after source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair; remaining limitations are explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.note: DBAASP assay values map to source text, but local paper/database packet does not provide a DBAASP-verifiable Cyclosporin A sequence/modification record.
Activity layer is anticancer/cytotoxicity evidence for cyclosporine/nanoformulation in human breast cell lines, not antimicrobial MIC evidence.
Figure 9 was inspected; only exact values printed in text/Table 7 were promoted to rows. Unlabeled middle-dose bars were not fabricated.
Local supplementary assets are landing/support HTML-like files with no parsed structured activity table; XML/PDF/OA package supplied the gate-changing evidence.
Mechanism layer is limited to targeted-delivery/computational/phenotypic context; no direct killing mechanism claim is made.
